description: Create a table in a new text frame on the active page (or pageIndex)

headerRows.description: Number of header rows (must be less than rows; default 1 when rows > 1)

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

rows.description: Total number of rows, including header rows

width.description: Frame and table width in mm

x.description: X position in mm from the page left edge; omitted values are placed automatically

y.description: Y position in mm from the page top edge

name: create_table
title: Create Table
